title: Saturating cores: tabulated B-H curve vs closed-form curve (magnetostatics, analytic)
description:
Planar magnetostatics, 1D in x: a current sheet (current_source J = -K / w in air, x in [0.6, 0.8] mm) beside two iron cores, magnetic insulation on x_lo (the mirror plane of the opposite return sheet), symmetry on x_hi and the y faces. Ampere fixes H_y = K in both cores whatever their permeability (the planar long solenoid / toroid: H = N I / l), so every core cell sits on its own B-H curve. core_table (x < 0.3 mm) is a bh_curve table sampled from the Frohlich-Kennelly curve at H = 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000 A/m (rows as parameter expressions); core_fk (0.3 - 0.6 mm) is that curve in closed form (mu_dc = 2000, saturation_polarization = 1.6 T). Saturation loop: Anderson, relaxation 0.5, tolerance 1e-8. The sweep runs K = 100 .. 10000 A/m on one reused build (reuse_build: the winding density follows K_drive, each loop starts from the previous value's permeabilities).
Analytic: B_table = linear interpolation of the table rows (from the origin; slope mu0 past the last row), B_fk = mu0 H + J_s a H / (1 + a H) with a = mu0 (mu_dc - 1) / J_s.
Derived values tab: H_cores (= K), B_table, B_fk and mu_secant_table (B / (mu0 H) of the table core, 1520 at 100 A/m -> 114 at 10000 A/m): exact finite-volume identities, expect ~1e-6 (loop tolerance, float32 field storage), tolerance 1e-4.
Sweep tab: B_table and B_fk vs K with their dashed references; fk_over_table draws the closed-form curve over the table series (reported, not checked): they meet at the rows, between rows the table chord lies below the concave curve (12 % at 100 A/m, 4.3 % at 350, 2.5 % at 1500, 2.7 % at 3500), and at 10000 A/m, past the last row, the table core is 5.6 % low (1.432 vs 1.517 T) since the table continues with slope mu0: end a table well into saturation. Use log axes.
Line profile tab (last sweep value, K = 10000 A/m): B_profile (field B_y): 1.432 T in the table core, 1.517 T in the closed-form core, mu0 H falling linearly to 0 across the sheet, 0 beyond.

parameters.name: K_drive
parameters.description: sheet current per m of height in A/m = the uniform H_y in both cores (swept 100 .. 10000)

parameters.name: mu_i
parameters.description: initial relative permeability mu_dc of the closed-form (Frohlich-Kennelly) curve

parameters.name: J_sat
parameters.description: saturation polarisation J_s in T: B -> mu0 H + J_s

parameters.name: a_fk
parameters.description: curve constant a = mu0 (mu_dc - 1) / J_s in m/A

parameters.name: H_row1
parameters.description: table row 1: H in A/m

parameters.name: H_row2
parameters.description: table row 2: H in A/m

parameters.name: H_row3
parameters.description: table row 3: H in A/m

parameters.name: H_row4
parameters.description: table row 4: H in A/m

parameters.name: H_row5
parameters.description: table row 5 (last): H in A/m; beyond it the table continues with slope mu0

parameters.name: B_row1
parameters.description: table row 1: B in T, the closed-form curve at H_row1 (0.3826 T)

parameters.name: B_row2
parameters.description: table row 2: B in T (0.7043 T)

parameters.name: B_row3
parameters.description: table row 3: B in T (0.9787 T)

parameters.name: B_row4
parameters.description: table row 4: B in T (1.2160 T)

parameters.name: B_row5
parameters.description: table row 5: B in T (1.4255 T)

parameters.name: B_table_ref
parameters.expression: B_row1/H_row1*min(K_drive, H_row1) + (B_row2 - B_row1)/(H_row2 - H_row1)*max(min(K_drive, H_row2) - H_row1, 0) + (B_row3 - B_row2)/(H_row3 - H_row2)*max(min(K_drive, H_row3) - H_row2, 0) + (B_row4 - B_row3)/(H_row4 - H_row3)*max(min(K_drive, H_row4) - H_row3, 0) + (B_row5 - B_row4)/(H_row5 - H_row4)*max(min(K_drive, H_row5) - H_row4, 0) + mu0_const*max(K_drive - H_row5, 0)
parameters.description: analytic B of the table core in T: piecewise-linear table at H = K_drive (sum of clipped segment ramps)

parameters.name: B_fk_ref
parameters.description: analytic B of the closed-form core in T at H = K_drive

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (100 x 10 cells)

parameters.name: L_x
parameters.description: domain length along x

parameters.name: h_y
parameters.description: domain height (symmetry y faces: the problem is 1D in x)

parameters.name: x_fk0
parameters.description: table core | closed-form core interface (a cell edge)

parameters.name: x_sheet0
parameters.description: closed-form core | current sheet interface (a cell edge)

parameters.name: x_sheet1
parameters.description: current sheet | air interface (a cell edge)

parameters.name: w_sheet
parameters.description: sheet thickness along x

analytic_curves.name: B_profile
analytic_curves.expression: where(x < x_fk0, B_table_ref, where(x < x_sheet0, B_fk_ref, where(x < x_sheet1, mu0_const*K_drive*(x_sheet1 - x)/w_sheet, 0)))
